title: Contract papers with the price left blank
question: Do any contract papers put before the board leave the price clause as template text?
finding: 2 of the 50 board attachments read leave the price clause as "INSERT DOLLAR AMOUNT IN WORDS": 24-25-FINAL--ISA - ROBERT HALF PROTIVITI GOVERNMENT SERVICES FY 2024-2025 v.1 (2024-06-25); 00006 After School Enrichment Program (McKinley) $57,000.01 (2026-06-09).
how: Searched each attachment's text (or OCR) for the template phrase inside the compensation clause; "$Enter Amount" in unticked budget-code options was not counted.
limits: The posted copy may be a draft attached for information; the executed copy, purchase order and board motion carry the amount. The agenda title of each item gives an amount.
